def analyze_market_data_from_csv(csv_path: str, coin: str):
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    df = df[df["coin"].str.upper() == coin.upper()]
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], unit="s", errors="ignore")
    df[["priceUSD","dailyVolumeUSD","totalLiquidityUSD"]] = df[["priceUSD","dailyVolumeUSD","totalLiquidityUSD"]].astype(float)
    df = df.sort_values("date")
    df["return"] = df["priceUSD"].pct_change()
    price_change_24h = ((df.iloc[-1]["priceUSD"]/df.iloc[-2]["priceUSD"])-1)*100
    volume_change_24h = ((df.iloc[-1]["dailyVolumeUSD"]/df.iloc[-2]["dailyVolumeUSD"])-1)*100
    return {
        "latest_price": df.iloc[-1]["priceUSD"],
        "24h_price_change_pct": price_change_24h,
        "24h_volume_change_pct": volume_change_24h,
        "daily_returns": df["return"].dropna().tolist(),
